scene_analysis.scene_overview: A tree-lined street in a residential area with apartment buildings on both sides. The street is relatively empty with only a few cars parked along the curb. There are several trees planted along the sidewalk, providing shade and adding aesthetic appeal to the area. The buildings have a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles, with some featuring balconies and others having more minimalist designs. The street itself is paved with asphalt and has white lines marking parking spaces and pedestrian crossings. The overall atmosphere is calm and peaceful, with a sense of community and tranquility.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings on either side of the street are primarily residential, with a mix of apartments and houses. Some have balconies, while others have large windows and doors. The facades are made of various materials, including brick, stucco, and wood. Some buildings appear to be older, with worn and weathered exteriors, while others look newer and more modern.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are tall and leafy, providing shade and adding to the ambiance of the area.
